subject: Bi-LSTM
source_sentence: Given a t-length sequence of word embedding vectors S = {w0, w1,...wt}, a bi-directional long short-term memory (Bi-LSTM) layer is used to encode S to a hidden representation , H = {h0, h1,...ht} ∈Rt×d, where d is the hidden dimension.
